blocks.x: Every service is delivered through the Achala Method — Diagnose, Design, Prove, Industrialize, Compound — with gates that finance and risk actually sign. Services arrive on platform rails where relevant, so production hardening (security, replay, monitoring, documentation) is inherited rather than rebuilt.

Every deliverable arrives with its control mapping: model cards, decision replay, DORA-grade third-party evidence, EU AI Act technical documentation — generated during delivery, never reconstructed for audit.
